purpose: Document first-party Korba/Chhattisgarh registry discovery, viewer configuration, bounded public requests, safe-field limits, and uncertainty.
assessment: Official Korba District Administration evidence establishes local land-record custody and links Chhattisgarh Bhuiyan/Bhu-Naksha. The current Bhu-Naksha JavaScript/configuration was inspected. Anonymous requests exposed administrative levels, a Korba village extent, and one safe plot identity, but no complete parcel polygon response was obtained.
registryAssessment: registryFound=true is supported by the official Korba District Administration page naming the Land Records Section, Office of the Collector, Korba and linking Bhuiyan/Bhu-Naksha. This is local service custody evidence only; it is not source integration, ownership evidence, or proof of citywide parcel availability.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official English Korba district page says citizens can obtain digitized P-II/B-I and Naksha through district, sub-divisional, tehsil and CSC channels, links bhuiyan.cg.nic.in, and identifies the Korba Collectorate Land Records Section.
Official Hindi Korba district page confirms the Bhuiyan/Bhu-Naksha route and Collectorate Land Records Section.
Current state Bhu-Naksha viewer exposed district, tehsil, RI and village selectors, OpenLayers map code, WMS layers, and REST MapInfo endpoints.
Official Chhattisgarh Revenue and Disaster Management Department site identifies Bhuiyan and Bhu-Naksha as state land-record projects.
District page's linked Bhuiyan land-record service; no separate safe parcel feature response was required or retained.

viewerConfiguration.schemaAndCrs: REST extent response returned xmin/ymin/xmax/ymax and gisCode 550101.058; the response did not state CRS. JavaScript uses OpenLayers and WMS but does not by itself establish a source CRS for retained geometry.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier if independently verified

attempts.result: Official page available; local Land Records Section and Bhuiyan/Bhu-Naksha route verified.
Official Hindi page available; same local custody and service route verified.

attempts.method: GET; anonymous public read with normal TLS
attempts.result: Viewer HTML available; current config.js and index.js retrieved. JavaScript identified REST Levels, REST MapInfo, ScalarDatahandler and WMS routes.
Returned 4 levels: district, tehsil, RI, village.

attempts.method: POST state=22, level=0/1/2 with bounded Korba codes
attempts.result: Returned Korba district code 55, Korba tehsil code 01, Korba-1 RI code 01, and Korba village code 058 among the official lists.
Returned Korba village gisCode 550101.058 and numeric map extent xmin=-3920.30687160258, ymin=305.274678938474, xmax=1784.42828402346, ymax=6124.52030200671; response did not state CRS.
Returned JSON id=LkyKPj-9SXeGEHGe9breKg and kide=188/1/क/5. This safe identity response contained no geometry and no owner/address data.

attempts.method: GET OP=5, state=22, levels=55,01,01,058,, empty plotno
attempts.result: Returned has_data=N with the same Korba village extent; no parcel feature geometry.

attempts.method: GET bounded GetFeatureInfo-shaped request for PLOT_LIST, with map extent, state, gis_code and safe plot_id
attempts.result: Returned a PNG map response rather than JSON feature geometry. No polygon retained; the request did not ask for unsafe fields.

geometryDecision: No full polygon retained; the public route yielded an identity and raster/WMS map behavior but no qualifying complete anonymous parcel polygon response.

geometryEvidence.exactWupPointTest: Not run against parcel geometry because no qualifying geometry endpoint was verified. Exact WUP point [22.3694566508547, 82.7271070816062] was preserved unchanged.
geometryEvidence.query: A bounded Korba village extent and one bounded map-coordinate identity query were submitted; no source geometry was retained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Korba District Administration land-record custody and Chhattisgarh Bhu-Naksha; one Korba village map extent was inspected.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Administrative selection metadata, village extent, and one safe native plot identity; no complete polygon feature response.

remainingUncertainty: The exact WUP point was not shifted. The inspected village extent is not a city boundary, and no zero-hit or map miss is treated as citywide absence. Public polygon serialization, authoritative CRS, full native schema, urban coverage, stable identity semantics, and citywide completeness remain unverified.

runtimeAssessment.reason: No independent anonymous ID-plus-complete-polygon response; this packet does not qualify an adapter or enable runtime.
